title: Databases: View-specific field and entry ordering
description:
Organize your work more effectively in Confluence by setting unique field and entry orders for each database view. This change allows you to tailor how information is displayed across different views within the same database, ensuring that the most relevant data is always prioritized for your specific needs. To get started with this change: Open a database in Confluence.
	Create a new table view or select an existing one.
	Drag and move fields or entries to your preferred order.
